content.value_statement: Backend teams need consistent architecture, database, and security guidance across services. This skill provides focused prompts, references, and helper scripts for API design and backend review.
actual_capabilities: Documents backend topics for API patterns, database optimization, and security practices.
Provides Python CLI entry points for scaffolding, migration review, and load testing workflows.
Validates that a target path exists before producing a simple analysis report.
Prints status, target path, and finding counts for script runs.
Can emit a JSON results file when users pass --json and --output.
limitations: The helper scripts contain placeholder analysis logic and do not generate production code.
The references are generic and require project-specific engineering judgment.
The skill does not connect to live databases, services, or cloud providers.
The skill does not replace formal security review or load testing tools.

use_cases.title: Plan a New API
use_cases.description: Use the API design notes to outline endpoints, validation, and service boundaries before implementation.

use_cases.title: Review Service Readiness
use_cases.description: Check backend changes against database, performance, and security considerations before a release.

use_cases.title: Bootstrap Team Standards
use_cases.description: Create shared backend review prompts and quality checklists for teams using Claude, Codex, or Claude Code.

prompt_templates.title: Review an API Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the senior-backend skill to review my API plan. Check endpoint shape, validation, authentication, database access, and missing tests.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Database Options
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the database optimization guide to compare these schema changes. Identify indexing risks, migration order, rollback needs, and monitoring signals.

prompt_templates.title: Harden a Backend Service
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the backend security practices reference to review this service. Focus on authorization boundaries, input validation, secret handling, and audit logging.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Release Readiness Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Use all senior-backend references to create a release review for this backend change. Include API, database, performance, security, and operational checks.

output_examples.input: Review a proposed user management API before implementation.
output: Endpoint boundaries are clear, but role checks need explicit ownership rules.
Add validation for email updates and rate limits on password flows.
Plan integration tests for authentication, authorization, and duplicate user handling.

output_examples.input: Assess a database migration for a high-traffic table.
output_examples.output: The migration should be split into additive schema changes, backfill, and constraint enforcement. Add rollback notes and monitor lock duration.

output_examples.input: Create a backend security review checklist.
output: Confirm authentication and authorization boundaries for every sensitive action.
Check input validation, parameterized queries, and secret handling.
Add logging and monitoring for failed access attempts and unusual traffic.

best_practices: Share architecture context, data model notes, and expected traffic before asking for recommendations.
Ask the skill to separate must-fix risks from optional improvements.
Review generated command suggestions before running them in a project workspace.
anti_patterns: Treating generic reference text as project-specific security approval.
Running helper scripts against sensitive directories without understanding the output path.
Expecting the placeholder scripts to perform full scaffolding, migration, or load-testing work.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps structure backend API, database, performance, and security reviews for service development.

faq.question: Does it create production backend code?
faq.answer: No. The included scripts are basic helpers and the references are guidance.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude Code and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. It declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it require network access?
faq.answer: No evidence found that the included scripts make network requests.

faq.question: Can it modify files?
faq.answer: The scripts can write a JSON report only when you pass --json and --output.

faq.question: Should I run every command in SKILL.md?
faq.answer: No. Review commands first and run only those that match your project and environment.
